# Data dictionary — SYNTHETIC demonstration data

**Provenance:** Every CSV in `data/raw/` is generated by `scripts/generate_data.py` with a fixed random seed (`42`). These tables are **synthetic demonstration data** for the OreSight hackathon MVP.

They are **not** real MOIL data, not National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR) extracts, and not measurements from any operating mine. Do not cite them as operational or statutory reserves.

**Demonstration mine:** `mine_id = DEMO-01`  
**Calendar:** daily rows from `2023-01-01` through `2025-12-31` (inclusive), shared across all operational tables.  
**Units:** SI / mining-conventional as listed below. Values are clipped to avoid negatives and other impossible combinations.

Geological grades are spatially correlated and concentrated in a folded, stratabound ore zone. Nearby coordinates tend to have similar Mn. Ore is **not** uniform across the mine.

---

## boreholes.csv

One row per synthetic drillhole. `Mn_pct` / `Fe_pct` / `SiO2_pct` / `density` are length-weighted composites along the hole (ore-horizon samples weighted more). Coordinates are metres in a local mine grid.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hole_id | — | Unique hole identifier (`BH-001` …). |
| x | m | Easting (local grid). |
| y | m | Northing (local grid). |
| collar_z | m | Collar elevation. |
| depth | m | Hole length (positive downward from collar). |
| Mn_pct | % | Composite manganese grade (elemental Mn, demonstration range). |
| Fe_pct | % | Composite iron grade. |
| SiO2_pct | % | Composite silica. |
| density | t/m³ | Composite dry bulk density. |

---

## blocks.csv

Regular 3D block model (~2,000–3,000 cells) covering the demonstration deposit. Density follows the same synthetic grade field used for boreholes. **No grade columns** here; later modules may estimate grade from boreholes.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| block_id | — | Unique block identifier (`BLK-0001` …). |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| x | m | Block centroid easting. |
| y | m | Block centroid northing. |
| z | m | Block centroid elevation. |
| volume_m3 | m³ | Block volume. |
| density | t/m³ | Synthetic bulk density at the centroid. |

---

## production.csv

Daily plant / ROM production for `DEMO-01`. `actual_t` is generated from planned tonnes plus rainfall, fleet downtime/availability, blast delay, development advance, manpower, shifts, and seasonality. Heavy rain and high downtime generally reduce actual tonnes.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day (aligned with other operational files). |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| planned_t | t | Planned ROM tonnes for the day. |
| actual_t | t | Realised ROM tonnes (synthetic). |
| avg_mn_pct | % | Average Mn in tonnes produced that day. |

---

## equipment.csv

One row per machine per day. Downtime rises with rainfall; failures are more likely in wet weather and after a previous failure.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day. |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| equipment_id | — | Asset id (e.g. `SH-01`, `DU-03`). Unique together with `date`. |
| equipment_type | — | `shovel`, `dumper`, `drill`, `loader`, or `dozer`. |
| downtime_h | h | Hours unavailable (0–22). |
| availability | fraction | `1 - downtime_h/24`, clipped to (0, 1]. |
| failure | 0/1 | 1 if a failure event was recorded that day. |
| repair_h | h | Repair hours; 0 when `failure = 0`. |

---

## blast.csv

Daily blasting activity. Delays are more common on wet days (`delay_reason` often `rainfall` / `wet_holes`).

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day. |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| blast_count | count | Number of blasts (integer ≥ 0). |
| delay_h | h | Hours of blast-related delay; 0 if none. |
| delay_reason | — | `none` or a coded reason (`rainfall`, `wet_holes`, `misfire`, `ventilation`, `equipment`, `ground_conditions`). |

---

## development.csv

Daily underground / bench development advance. Lower during the monsoon and on high-rainfall days.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day. |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| development_m | m | Advance for the day (≥ 0). |

---

## manpower.csv

Daily labour availability. Absenteeism increases in monsoon / heavy rain; shifts may drop from 3 to 2 in peak monsoon.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day. |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| available_workers | persons | Headcount available (≥ 0). |
| shifts | count | Scheduled shifts (1–3). |

---

## weather.csv

Synthetic site weather with an **Indian monsoon-like** seasonal cycle (wet ~ June–September, peak ~ late July). `soil_moisture` is a lagged function of rainfall. `NDVI` greener after wet soils. `LST` hotter in pre-monsoon, cooler in monsoon and winter.

These are **not** satellite products and **not** IMD station records.

| Column | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar day. |
| mine_id | — | Always `DEMO-01`. |
| rainfall_mm | mm | Daily rainfall (≥ 0). |
| soil_moisture | fraction | 0–1 volumetric-style moisture index. |
| NDVI | — | Vegetation index ~0.1–0.8 (synthetic). |
| LST | °C | Land / site temperature (synthetic). |
